ja459:1.1: Mitto mittassa pānīyaṃ adinnaṃ paribhuñjisaṃ, tena pacchā vijigucchiṃ taṃ pāpaṃ pakatam mayā, mā puna akaraṃ pāpaṃ tasmā pabbajito ahaṃ.
ja459:2.1: Paradārañ ca disvāna chando me udapajjatha, tena pacchā vijigucchiṃ taṃ pāpaṃ pakatam mayā, mā puna akaraṃ pāpaṃ tasmā pabbajito ahaṃ.
ja459:3.1: Pitaraṃ me mahārāja corā agaṇhuṃ kānane, tes' āhaṃ pucchito jānaṃ aññathā naṃ viyākariṃ,
ja459:5.1: Pāṇātipātam akaruṃ somayāge upaṭṭhite, tes' āhaṃ samanuññāsiṃ,
ja459:7.1: Surāmerayamadhukā ye janā paṭham' āsu no bahunnaṃ te anatthāya majjapānam akappayuṃ, tes' āhaṃ samanuññāsiṃ,
ja459:8.1: tena pacchā vijigucchiṃ taṃ pāpaṃ pakatam mayā, mā puna akaraṃ pāpaṃ tasmā pabbajito ahan ti
ja459:9.1: Dhi-r-atthu subahū kāme duggandhe bahukaṇṭake ye aham patisevanto na labhiṃ tādisaṃ sukham ti
ja459:10.1: Mahassādā sukhā kāmā, n' atthi kāmaparaṃ sukhaṃ, ye kāme patisevanti saggan te upapajjare ti.
ja459:11.1: Appassādā dukkhā kāmā, n' atthi kāmaparaṃ dukhaṃ, ye kāme patisevanti nirayan te upapajjare.
ja459:12.1: Asi yathā sunisito nettiṃso va supāyiko sattīva urasī khitto -- kāmā dukkhatarā tato.
ja459:13.1: Aṅgārānaṃ va jalitaṃ kāsuṃ sādhikaporisaṃ phālaṃ va divasaṃtattaṃ -- kāmā dukkhatarā tato.
ja459:14.1: Visaṃ yathā halāhalaṃ telam ukkaṭṭhitaṃ yathā tambalohavilīnaṃ va -- kāmā dukkhatarā tato ti.
